description: The provided image consists of two pie charts, labeled (a) and (b), representing the co-occurrence of different tokens with the word "reaction" in the domains of chemistry and mathematics, respectively. The slices are arranged in descending order by size in a clockwise direction starting from the top right. The categories include "the" (blue hatched pattern) at 31%, "this" (light blue with horizontal stripes) at 21%, "for" (green checked pattern) at 17%, "chemical" (light green patterned) at 15%, "to" (yellow with wavy lines) at 9%, and "in" (very light blue with vertical stripes) at 7%. Chart (b) represents the mathematics domain and displays four categories, also arranged clockwise in descending size from the top right with a corresponding legend above. Its slices consist of "the" (blue hatched pattern) at 38%, "$" (pink dotted pattern) at 27%, "equilibrium" (yellow checked pattern) at 19%, and "consatant" (grey dotted pattern) at 15%. In both charts, numerical percentage labels are positioned just outside the perimeter of their respective slices. Neither chart features visually emphasized segments, such as exploded, offset, or bolded slices.
